name: Iloperidone
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Undergoes carbonyl reduction, CYP2D6 hydroxylation and CYP3A4 O-demethylation. P88 is an active metabolite. Drug-related material is eliminated through urine and feces.
